extracted.intended_audience: state environmental agency staff, regulated sources in Connecticut, EPA staff, regulatory attorneys, and members of the public following SIP actions
extracted.subtask_description: A Federal Register correction to a final EPA rule approving Connecticut's SIP revision that replaces RCSA section 22a-174-4 with 22a-174-4a, adding monitoring, recordkeeping, and reporting requirements and inserting the missing words of issuance. The page documents the correction, effective date, docket handling, and legal justification for issuing the correction without prior notice and comment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Source monitoring, record keeping and reporting requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: The principal SIP revision is replacement of RCSA section 22a-174-4 with a new section 22a-174-4a, called 'source monitoring, record keeping and reporting.' This SIP revision provides monitoring, recordkeeping and reporting requirements to ensure that certain sources comply with applicable emissions limitations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Purpose: ensure sources comply with applicable emissions limitations. (The document does not reproduce the specific monitoring/recordkeeping/reporting provisions; see docketed regulatory text and supporting documents for details.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Approval criterion for SIP revisions (as applied here)
rubrics_metrics.description: EPA approved State Implementation Plan (SIP) revisions submitted by the State of Connecticut which address source monitoring in Connecticut, by incorporating the new regulation into the Connecticut SIP.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The approval is reflected by amending 40 CFR part 52 to include the state regulation; supporting materials and prior notices are in the docket (EPA-R01-OAR-2023-0377).

rubrics_metrics.name: Effective date and publication form requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: The rule is effective on August 7, 2024. The document has been published in the Federal Register; the PDF linked in the document sidebar is the official electronic format.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: FederalRegister.gov XML is an unofficial prototype and does not replace the official print or the official electronic PDF on govinfo.gov; users relying on it for legal research should verify against an official edition.

rubrics_metrics.name: Docket availability and handling of non-public materials
rubrics_metrics.description: EPA has established a docket for this action under Docket Identification No. EPA-R01-OAR-2023-0377. All documents in the docket are listed on Regulations.gov, but some information is not publicly available (e.g., CBI or material restricted by statute). Certain materials, such as copyrighted material, may be available only in hard copy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Publicly available docket materials are accessible at Regulations.gov or at the EPA Region 1 office; EPA requests scheduling an inspection by contacting the person listed in FOR FURTHER INFORMATION CONTACT. Official office hours provided.

rubrics_metrics.name: Good cause exception to notice-and-comment (5 U.S.C. 553(b)(B))
rubrics_metrics.description: EPA has determined there is good cause for making this rule final without prior proposal and opportunity for comment because the action is adding language that was accidentally omitted; thus notice and public procedure are unnecessary.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Legal basis: section 553(b)(B) of the Administrative Procedure Act. Used here because the correction merely inserts omitted 'Words of Issuance' connecting the preamble to the regulatory text; the correction does not change the substance of the final action.

rubrics_metrics.name: Words of Issuance requirement in final regulatory text
rubrics_metrics.description: The final rule must include the 'Words of Issuance' sentence connecting the preamble to the regulatory text: 'For the reasons stated in the preamble, EPA amends part 52 of chapter I, title 40 of the Code of Federal Regulations as follows:'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This correction adds that missing sentence immediately before 'PART 52—APPROVAL AND PROMULGATION OF IMPLEMENTATION PLANS' to ensure the regulatory text is properly framed and linked to the preamble.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public comment status and timing
rubrics_metrics.description: Comments are no longer being accepted for this action; see the DATES section for details.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The document notes the public comment period has closed for this rulemaking (this is a correction to a final rule).

rubrics_metrics.name: Document metadata/headings convention
rubrics_metrics.description: Document headings may contain: the agency or agencies that issued and signed a document; the CFR title and number of each part the document amends or relates to; the agency docket number/internal file number; and the RIN identifying the regulatory action in the Unified Agenda.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For more details on drafting conventions, see the Document Drafting Handbook referenced in the page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of official editions for legal notice
rubrics_metrics.description: Only official editions of the Federal Register provide legal notice to the public and judicial notice to the courts under 44 U.S.C. 1503 & 1507.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verify contents against a final, official edition when using public inspection listings or conducting legal research; the XML prototype on FederalRegister.gov does not provide legal notice until ACFR grants it official status.
